remind.question: Get notifications about deadlines and your week? {{product}} schedules them a week ahead, so they arrive even when it's closed.
remind.onDone: {{product}} will remind you. You can change this in Settings ▸ Reminders.
remind.offDone: No reminders. You can turn them on in Settings ▸ Reminders.

settings.notifyHint: {{product}} schedules reminders a week ahead, so they arrive even when it's closed. Open it at least once a week to keep them coming.
settings.notDetermined: macOS asks whether {{product}} may send notifications when you turn this on.
settings.denied: Notifications from {{product}} are turned off in System Settings, so reminders show only inside {{product}}.

general.menuBarHint: Your week at a glance. Closing the last window then leaves {{product}} running in the menu bar.
general.loginApproval: macOS needs your approval in System Settings ▸ General ▸ Login Items.
general.loginUnavailable: This copy of {{product}} can't be added to the login items. Move it to the Applications folder and open it from there.
general.loginFailed: {{product}} couldn't be added to or removed from the login items.
